issues.title: Git AI Review 在 Node.js 25 上 body.on 失敗
issues.description:
在 `packages/server/src/routes/vibe-fs.mjs` 的 `/api/vibe-git/ai-comment` 端點中，`chatRes.body.on("data", ...)` 在 Node.js 25 上會拋出 `chatRes.body.on is not a function`。因為 Node.js 18+ 的 `fetch()` 回傳的是 `ReadableStream`（Web API），不是 Node.js 的 `IncomingMessage` stream，所以沒有 `.on()` 方法。應該改用 `for await (const chunk of chatRes.body)` 或 `chatRes.body.getReader()`。

目前 catch block 會回傳基本分析，但不會產生真正的 AI review。

issues.title: dependency-context.mjs: 跨平台路徑正規化違反標準、無快取、dead code
issues.description:
從架構審查 dependency-context.mjs 發現三個技術債：
1. [P0] 路徑正規化寫死 replace(cwd + "/", "") 和 replace(/^\//, "")，未使用專案標準的 split(/[\\/]/)，在 Windows 上可能出錯
2. [P1] 每次 getDependencyContext 呼叫都重新讀取 4 個 JSON 檔（無 module-level cache），agent loop 內連續 edit 10 個檔案 = 40 次 I/O
3. [P2] getImpactSummary (35行) 完全無人引用，是 dead code
4. [P3] getAffectedTests 內的 convention-based test detection 邏輯有變數但從未加入 return set，形同 dead code

issues.title: coding-health.mjs reads wrong issues filename (issues.json vs ISSUES.json)
issues.description:
## Bug: Issues check always reports 0 issues

**File:** `packages/server/src/routes/coding-health.mjs` line 108

**Problem:** The health check reads `.paaw/issues/issues.json` (lowercase), but the actual file created by `coding-issues.mjs` is `.paaw/issues/ISSUES.json` (uppercase). On case-sensitive filesystems (Linux production servers), this means the issues check ALWAYS returns 0 issues — a false "healthy" signal.

**Evidence:**
- `coding-health.mjs:108` → `join(projRoot, ".paaw", "issues", "issues.json")` ❌ lowercase
- `coding-issues.mjs:51` → `join(projectPath, ".paaw", "issues", "ISSUES.json")` ✅ uppercase
- Actual file on disk: `ISSUES.json` (confirmed via `ls`)

**Impact:** The health endpoint reports `issues: { total: 0, open: 0 }` even when there are real open issues. This makes the health check unreliable for monitoring. On macOS (case-insensitive HFS+) it accidentally works, but will break on Linux deployment.

**Fix:** Change line 108 to use `"ISSUES.json"` to match the canonical filename.

coding-health.mjs: issues 檔案路徑大小寫錯誤 (issues.json vs ISSUES.json)
issues.description:
在 `packages/server/src/routes/coding-health.mjs` 第 108 行：

```js
const issuesFile = join(projRoot, ".paaw", "issues", "issues.json");
```

實際檔案名稱是大寫的 `ISSUES.json`（所有其他檔案都用大寫：coding-features.mjs:82, coding-issues.mjs:51, tools/index.mjs:730, paaw-agent-loop.mjs:1309 等等）。

**影響：** Health Check 的 Issues 檢查永遠找不到檔案（`existsSync` 回傳 false），所以 `total` 和 `open` 永遠為 0。使用者看到健康檢查一切正常，但其實有 open issues 沒被計入。

**修復：** 將第 108 行 `"issues.json"` 改為 `"ISSUES.json"`。

**發現者：** Helpdesk Night Shift 2026-07-18

issues.title: coding-reports.mjs: dateMatch variable scope is confusing (code clarity)
issues.description:
## Bug: Uninitialized variable when no list endpoint matches

**File:** `packages/server/src/routes/coding-reports.mjs` lines 77, 101, 103

**Problem:** `dateMatch` is assigned on line 77 inside the GET handler block scope, but the DELETE handler on line 101 references `dateMatch` which may be out of scope or undefined.

Looking more carefully at the code:
```js
// Line 77: defined here
const dateMatch = url.match(/\/api\/coding-reports\/([\d-]+)/);
if (req.method === 'GET' && dateMatch) { ... }  // line 78

// Line 101: DELETE handler
if (req.method === 'DELETE' && dateMatch) { ... }  // ← references dateMatch
```

Since `dateMatch` is declared with `const` at line 77 (function scope), the DELETE handler CAN access it. However, the regex runs unconditionally even for the `/list` endpoint, doing unnecessary work. More importantly, if the URL is `/api/coding-reports/list`, `dateMatch` will be `null` (no digits match), which is fine, but the logic is fragile.

**Actual concern:** The regex `/\/api\/coding-reports\/([\d-]+)/` will ALSO match `/api/coding-reports/list` path checking — wait, no, "list" has no digits so it won't match. This is actually OK.

**Downgrading:** This is a code clarity issue, not a bug. The variable is accessible. Recommend adding a comment or restructuring for readability.

**Severity adjusted to low.**

issues.title: ReportsTab: ReactMarkdown renders AI-generated content (safe, but document constraints)
issues.description:
## Performance: ReactMarkdown renders untrusted content

**File:** `packages/ui/src/components/ReportsTab.tsx`

**Problem:** The Reports tab renders report content using `<ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}>{content}</ReactMarkdown>`. The content comes from `.paaw/overnight-reports/*.md` files which are generated by AI agents (EM, Night Shift). While ReactMarkdown is generally safe against XSS (it doesn't render raw HTML by default), there are considerations:

1. **XSS via raw HTML:** ReactMarkdown v6+ does NOT render raw HTML by default (good). But if `rehype-raw` is ever added, it would be dangerous.
2. **Prompt injection in reports:** AI-generated reports could contain markdown that tricks users (e.g., fake links, misleading formatting). This is a lower risk since reports are internal.

**Current status:** Safe as implemented. ReactMarkdown sanitizes HTML by default.

**Recommendation:** Document that `rehype-raw` must NEVER be added to this pipeline without sanitization. Consider adding a code comment.

**Severity: low** (informational, current implementation is safe)

issues.title: ReportsTab: deleteReport uses stale reports array for fallback selection (works but fragile)
issues.description:
## Bug: ReportsTab stale closure in deleteReport selection

**File:** `packages/ui/src/components/ReportsTab.tsx`

**Problem:** In `deleteReport`, after deleting a report, if the deleted report was selected, the code tries to select the first remaining report:
```js
if (selectedDate === date) {
  setSelectedDate(reports.find(r => r.date !== date)?.date || null);
}
```

`reports` here is the state variable from the closure, which still contains the OLD list (before deletion). The `setReports(prev => prev.filter(...))` on the previous line updates state asynchronously, but `reports` in this scope is stale.

**Impact:** Usually works because `.find(r => r.date !== date)` finds the first report that isn't the deleted one — which is still valid even in the stale list. The selected date will be correct. However, there's an edge case: if there's only ONE report and you delete it, `find` returns `undefined`, and `setSelectedDate(null)` is called — which is correct.

**Actual behavior:** This works correctly in practice. The stale `reports` variable still has valid data for finding an alternative selection.

**Downgrading to low/informational.** The logic is correct but relies on stale closure behavior. A cleaner approach would use the functional update pattern or `useCallback` with proper deps.

**Severity: low**

issues.title: Night Shift runs all 6 agents in parallel without concurrency control (rate limit risk)
issues.description:
## Performance: Night Shift parallel agent execution without concurrency limit

**File:** `packages/server/src/routes/coding-night-shift.mjs`

**Problem:** Night Shift dispatches all 6 agents using `Promise.allSettled(agentRoles.map(...))`, running all agents in parallel. Each agent calls `runAgentLoop` which makes LLM API calls with up to 15 turns and 120s timeout.

**Impact:**
- 6 concurrent LLM sessions hitting the same provider simultaneously
- Rate limiting: Some providers (e.g., Z.AI, OpenRouter) have RPM (requests per minute) limits. 6 parallel long-running sessions may trigger 429 errors.
- Memory: Each agent loop accumulates conversation history. 6 parallel loops can use significant memory.
- The 10-minute global timeout may be too short if agents are queued behind rate limits.

**Recommendation:**
1. Consider a concurrency limiter (e.g., p-limit) to run 2-3 agents at a time
2. Or add jitter/staggered start (e.g., 5s delay between agent starts)
3. Monitor for 429 errors and add backoff retry at the Night Shift level

**Severity: medium** — works for now with 6 agents, but will degrade with more agents or stricter rate limits.

issues.title: Feature map refresh logic duplicated in 3 files (coding-night-shift, overnight-manager, coding-features)
issues.description:
## Performance: Night Shift Phase 0 feature map refresh duplicates code in 3 places

**File:** Multiple files

**Problem:** The "scan all source files + LLM prompt to refresh feature map" logic is duplicated nearly verbatim across:

1. `packages/server/src/routes/coding-night-shift.mjs` — Phase 0 inline (~80 lines)
2. `packages/server/src/lib/overnight-manager.mjs` — `refreshFeatureMapping()` (~80 lines)
3. `packages/server/src/routes/coding-features.mjs` — POST /refresh-mapping (~60 lines)

All three contain the same:
- Platform-specific `find` command (or Windows `node -e` one-liner)
- Same LLM prompt template (50+ lines)
- Same JSON recovery logic (brace counting)
- Same apply-updates loop

**Impact:**
- Maintenance burden: bug fixes must be applied in 3 places
- Inconsistency risk: the prompt in coding-features.mjs says "All Source Files in Codebase" without the count, while the other two include the count
- The commit `cea2539` ("same 3 fixes as refresh-mapping") demonstrates this pain — a fix had to be applied repeatedly

**Recommendation:** Extract to a shared function in `feature-map-validator.mjs` or a new `feature-map-refresher.mjs`:
```js
export async function refreshFeatureMapping(projRoot, modelOverride) {
  // single implementation
}
```

**Severity: medium** — tech debt, not a bug, but high ROI refactor.

issues.title: UI components access err.message without type narrowing (TypeScript strict mode)
Inconsistent path query parameter fallback across route files
issues.description:
## Code Quality: Inconsistent `path` query parameter handling across routes

**File:** Multiple route files

**Problem:** The `path` query parameter (project root) is resolved differently across routes:

1. **coding-health.mjs:** `url.searchParams.get("path") || PAAW_ROOT` — uses `PAAW_ROOT` constant ✓
2. **coding-night-shift.mjs:** `urlObj.searchParams.get("path") || PAAW_ROOT` — uses `PAAW_ROOT` constant ✓
3. **coding-reports.mjs:** `urlObj.searchParams.get("path") || process.env.PAAW_ROOT || process.cwd()` — uses `process.env` + `cwd()` fallback ⚠️
4. **coding-features.mjs:** Requires `path` param, returns 400 if missing ✓ (strictest)

**Impact:**
- `coding-reports.mjs` falls back to `process.cwd()` which may not be the project root if the server is started from a different directory
- Inconsistent behavior: some routes have PAAW_ROOT fallback, others use cwd, others require it

**Recommendation:** Standardize on the pattern in coding-health.mjs. All routes should use:
```js
const projRoot = parseQuery(req).path || PAAW_ROOT;
```
And ideally validate that the path is within an allowed root to prevent cross-project access.

**Severity: low** — works in practice but inconsistent.

issues.title: Critical: Health endpoint reads issues.json (lowercase) instead of ISSUES.json
issues.description:
## Bug: Case-sensitivity mismatch in coding-health.mjs

**File:** `packages/server/src/routes/coding-health.mjs` (line 108)

**Problem:** The health endpoint reads `.paaw/issues/issues.json` (lowercase), but every other module in the codebase writes/reads `.paaw/issues/ISSUES.json` (uppercase). This was confirmed by grep:
- `coding-issues.mjs`: uses `ISSUES.json`
- `coding-features.mjs`: uses `ISSUES.json`
- `paaw-agent-loop.mjs`: uses `ISSUES.json` (4 occurrences)
- `tools/index.mjs`: uses `ISSUES.json`
- `coding-health.mjs`: uses `issues.json` ← **WRONG**

**Impact:** On case-sensitive filesystems (Linux, CI environments), the health check always reports `total: 0, open: 0` because it reads from a non-existent file. This means the health check shows a false "ok" status for issues, masking real problems. On macOS (default case-insensitive), it works by accident.

**Fix:** Change line 108 from `join(projRoot, ".paaw", "issues", "issues.json")` to `join(projRoot, ".paaw", "issues", "ISSUES.json")`.

**Severity:** High — health checks are used by Night Shift and EM for decision-making; wrong issue data can lead to missed work items.

issues.title: Tech Debt: Duplicated feature-map refresh logic in 3 locations
issues.description:
## DRY Violation: Feature map refresh + JSON recovery logic duplicated

**Files affected:**
1. `packages/server/src/lib/overnight-manager.mjs` — `refreshFeatureMapping()` function
2. `packages/server/src/routes/coding-night-shift.mjs` — inline Phase 0 refresh (lines ~155-230)
3. `packages/server/src/routes/coding-features.mjs` — `/refresh-mapping` endpoint

**Problem:** All three contain nearly identical code:
- The same LLM prompt (~30 lines) for feature mapping refresh
- The same source-file scanning command (with Windows/macOS branching)
- The same JSON truncation recovery logic (~20 lines of brace-counting)
- The same update application loop

**Impact:**
- Maintenance burden: any change (e.g., prompt improvement, new file type) must be applied in 3 places
- Risk of divergence: the 3 copies are already slightly different (overnight-manager passes `modelOverride`, night-shift uses `PAAW_ROOT` for LLM config, features route uses inline `fetch`)

**Recommendation:** Extract a shared `refreshFeatureMapping(projectRoot, { modelOverride, providersFile })` function into `feature-map-validator.mjs` or a new `feature-map-refresher.mjs` module. Both overnight-manager and night-shift should call it. The coding-features route should also call it (replacing its inline implementation).

This is architecture-level — please assign to Developer (Priya) for refactoring.

issues.title: Race condition: Force reset 與 async Night Shift run 的 status.json 競態
issues.description:
在 coding-night-shift.mjs 中，當使用者點擊 Force Reset 按鈕將 status 設為 "interrupted" 後，背景 async run 的 sendSSE callback 和 10-min timeout handler 仍然會繼續寫入 status.json，可能蓋回 "running" 或 "failed"。

修復方向：在 sendSSE callback 和 timeout handler 中，寫入 status.json 前先檢查 currentStatus.status 是否仍為 "running"，若不是則直接 return。

詳見 QA Code Review 2026-07-19 報告。

notes.text: Fixed in commit d8e5d73: Introduced updateStatusFile() atomic write helper that centralizes all status.json writes. All progress updates now check for "interrupted" state and refuse to clobber it. The /reset endpoint is respected.

issues.title: Legacy route /api/coding-crew/overnight-report 仍指向已不寫入的 .paaw/overnight-reports/
issues.description:
coding.mjs 第 839 行的 GET /api/coding-crew/overnight-report 路由仍然讀取 .paaw/overnight-reports/，但重構後的 night-shift-shared.mjs 已移除所有 backward compat 程式碼，報告統一寫入 .paaw/night-shift/reports/。

影響：所有呼叫舊 API 的程式（如 EMDashboard 的 onOpenReportTab）都會返回 { exists: false }。

修復方向：將此路由指向新的 .paaw/night-shift/reports/ 路徑，或移除該路由並導向 /api/coding-night-shift/report。

notes.text: Fixed in commit 9441c67: Removed dead legacy route /api/coding-crew/overnight-report from coding.mjs. It referenced non-existent .paaw/overnight-reports/ directory and called undefined sendJSON function. Frontend had zero references to this endpoint.

issues.title: EMDashboard 的 Night Shift polling 讀取不存在的 sd.results
